change: Retry cleanup for rejected asset files and stale filesystem orphans, including pending uploads left by an interrupted account deletion.

policy.pending_uploads: Reject and remove immediately when an account is deleted; retry rejected files during the daily asset cleanup.
policy.unreferenced_uploads: Remove only after they are at least 24 hours old.
policy.active_pending_or_ready_uploads: Keep while referenced by the database.
policy.shared_room_note_body: Existing 30-day post-room retention behavior remains; account-deletion policy confirmation is still open.

assertions: REJECTED source and thumbnail files are removed.
Unreferenced image and temporary upload files older than 24 hours are removed.
A PENDING upload still referenced by the database is retained.
A recent unreferenced upload is retained.

scope: The user API and verified SSO account-deletion policy were not changed.
